title: Fake People, Real Consequences
summary: How bots, fake crowds and fake personas are used to manipulate people, and what the evidence says about whether it works.
abstract: This deck is about fake people online and the system that makes them worth building. I wanted to answer four questions. How do social media companies make money from us? How much of what we see online is automated? What does it cost to fake a crowd? And what happens when that fakery is aimed at an argument, an election or one person?

I’ve pulled together published research, company results, regulator findings and investigative journalism. Where a figure comes from a vendor or a government with a stake in it, I say so. Sources are listed at the foot of each page and in full at the end.
author: Adam Welbourne
footer: Fake People, Real Consequences · A. Welbourne · 2026
